description: Return EDGAR data-quality issues with deterministic ordering: severity DESC, cik ASC, fiscal_year ASC NULLS LAST, fiscal_period ASC NULLS LAST, rule_code ASC, with a fixed tie-break so pages never overlap. All filters are optional, so the listing can be browsed across the whole corpus. An issue describes the statement a read serves now, so a finding recorded against a statement that a later filing has replaced is not reported here; the data-quality overlay for a statement answers for that statement alone.

cik.description: Optional company CIK filter. Send this or `ticker`, not both.

ticker.description: Optional company filter by ticker symbol, in place of `cik`.

name: data_quality_issues
title: List public data-quality issues
